assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, heritage lines, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: All spatial moves are conceptual suggestions for professional deepening; no statutory FAR/height/demolition conclusions are claimed.

assumptions.statement: Site and key-area polygons are provisional_constraint from brief/site-package/geometry/provisional_boundaries.geojson.
assumptions.impact: Areas and topology are recalculable for intake discussion only; full recomputation required when official polygons are published.

assumptions.statement: Design judgments follow Chinese urban human-settlement science (people-nature-society-dwelling-network), organic renewal, and people-centered smart-city principles.
assumptions.impact: Technology proposals are filtered by real resident needs, equity, and long-term maintainability rather than demo-tech spectacle.
